newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung signs P&WC engine licence deal.
newsitem.headline: Samsung signs P&WC engine licence deal.

text.p: Samsung Aerospace Industries Co Ltd said on Wednesday it has signed an agreement with Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) to build under license engines for the Bell Helicopter Textron 427 light twin engine helicopter.
The deal was signed late on Tuesday, a Samsung Aerospace spokesman said.
"We will start to manufacture the engines, using P&WC's technology, starting in 1999, and we plan to make 30 engines a year," he said.
Samsung is a partner in Bell's 427 helicopter programme and will manufacture the aircraft's cabin, fuselage and tail boom in South Korea, Samsung officals said earlier during the Seoul Air Show.
Under the agreement, Samsung will assemble, test, as well as offer repair and overhaul services for the PW206D turboshaft engine for helicopters manufactured in South Korea.
P&WC is a unit of U.S.-based United Technologies Corp.
